```{=html}
<style>
  #flashcard {
    border: 2px solid #007bc2;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 30px;
    margin: 20px 0;
    text-align: center;
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: 150px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    transition: background-color 0.2s;
  }
  #flashcard:hover {
    background-color: #e9ecef;
  }
  #card-prompt {
    font-size: 1.25em;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  /* The answer section is hidden by default and faded in when active */
  #card-answer-container {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #card-answer-container.visible {
    display: flex;
    animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-in;
  }
  #card-divider {
    width: 80%;
    border: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #ccc;
    margin: 15px 0;
  }
  #card-answer {
    font-size: 1.25em;
    color: #007bc2;
  }
  #card-hint {
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #6c757d;
    margin-top: 20px;
  }

  @keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }
</style>

<div id="flashcard" onclick="handleCardClick()">
<div id="card-prompt">Loading flashcards...</div>
<div id="card-answer-container">
<hr id="card-divider">
<div id="card-answer"></div>
</div>
<div id="card-hint"></div>
</div>

<script>
  let cardData = [];
  let isShowingAnswer = false;

  const promptEl = document.getElementById('card-prompt');
  const answerContainerEl = document.getElementById('card-answer-container');
  const answerEl = document.getElementById('card-answer');
  const hintEl = document.getElementById('card-hint');

  // STEP 1: Fetch and parse the CSV file
  fetch('/03-practico/02-analisis/flashcards.csv')
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not load CSV file.");
      return response.text();
    })
    .then(csvText => {
      cardData = parseCSV(csvText);
      if (cardData.length > 0) {
        showRandomPrompt();
      } else {
        promptEl.innerText = "Error: CSV is empty.";
      }
    })
    .catch(error => {
      promptEl.innerText = "Error: Could not load flashcards.csv";
      console.error(error);
    });

  // STEP 2: Logic for clicking the card
  function handleCardClick() {
    if (cardData.length === 0) return; // Do nothing if data hasn't loaded

    if (!isShowingAnswer) {
      // Reveal the answer section without removing the prompt
      answerContainerEl.classList.add('visible');
      hintEl.innerText = "(Click for next question)";
      isShowingAnswer = true;
    } else {
      // Hide the answer and show a new random prompt
      showRandomPrompt();
    }
  }

  // STEP 3: Function to pick and display a random row
  function showRandomPrompt() {
    const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * cardData.length);
    const row = cardData[randomIndex];

    // Set the text for both elements
    promptEl.innerText = row[0];
    answerEl.innerText = row[1];

    // Ensure the answer is hidden initially
    answerContainerEl.classList.remove('visible');
    hintEl.innerText = "(Click to reveal answer)";
    isShowingAnswer = false;
  }

  // Helper: A robust CSV parser that handles quoted text containing commas
  function parseCSV(str) {
    const arr = [];
    let quote = false;
    let row = 0, col = 0;
    for (let c = 0; c < str.length; c++) {
      let cc = str[c], nc = str[c+1];
      arr[row] = arr[row] || [];
      arr[row][col] = arr[row][col] || '';

      if (cc == '"' && quote && nc == '"') { arr[row][col] += cc; ++c; continue; }
      if (cc == '"') { quote = !quote; continue; }
      if (cc == ',' && !quote) { ++col; continue; }
      if (cc == '\r' && nc == '\n' && !quote) { ++row; col = 0; ++c; continue; }
      if (cc == '\n' && !quote) { ++row; col = 0; continue; }
      if (cc == '\r' && !quote) { ++row; col = 0; continue; }

      arr[row][col] += cc;
    }
    // Return only valid rows with at least 2 columns
    return arr.filter(r => r.length >= 2 && r[0].trim() !== '');
  }
</script>
```
